reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: Pick the firm most likely to deliver the result with low execution risk, acceptable fees, and strong stakeholder confidence.

scenarios.label: Incumbent renewal
scenarios.description: Re-upping audit, tax, or ongoing advisory with the existing firm for another term.

scenarios.label: Finance transformation program
scenarios.description: Selecting a partner for a multi-year ERP and finance-process overhaul with significant change and spend.

scenarios.label: Managed services outsourcing
scenarios.description: Choosing a firm to run ongoing finance, SOX, or analytics operations under a long-term service agreement.

scenarios.label: Audit and assurance tender
scenarios.description: Running a formal RFP to appoint an external auditor or assurance provider under regulatory oversight.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Incumbent renewal|generic] Renewal for the team we've used for years is up next quarter. Feels like we're paying more for less senior time, delivery drifts, and I'm the one herding fixes. How do I tell if we stick or go without blowing up continuity with the board and controllers?

[problem_recognition|Finance transformation program|generic] Our monthly close drags to day 10+, forecasting is hand-stitched in spreadsheets, and we're about to replatform core finance systems. Team is exhausted and controls feel brittle. Where do I even start to unwind this?

[problem_recognition|Managed services outsourcing|generic] Our run-the-business costs keep creeping up while service levels keep slipping. AP, payroll, user access controls - constant escalations, too many handoffs, never enough coverage after hours. I need consistency and predictability without hiring a small army. What am I missing?

[problem_recognition|Audit and assurance tender|generic] Year-end sign-off is getting harder: endless PBC lists, new accounting standards, and last-minute surprises. Fees inch up but we still get churn on the team every year. How do I get a tighter, more reliable external review without chaos?

[category_education|-|generic] Plain English please: what do the big advisory and assurance outfits actually do for a finance overhaul, for running day-to-day processes, and for year-end sign-off? Where do the lines and conflicts sit?

[discovery|Incumbent renewal|generic] we're coming up on renewal. best fit partners for a long-term external assurance relationship that also supports complex accounting questions? we value continuity of the senior team and smooth audit committee prep.

[discovery|Finance transformation program|generic] Best firms for an end-to-end finance transformation: target operating model, close acceleration, data model redesign, and ERP migration for a multi-country manufacturer?

[discovery|Managed services outsourcing|generic] Who are the best providers for finance managed services - record to report, procure to pay, access controls, 24x7 coverage - with strong control discipline and clear SLAs?
[discovery|Audit and assurance tender|generic] Best external audit firms for a US-listed company with operations in 20+ countries, complex revenue recognition, and tight SOX timelines?

[shortlist|Incumbent renewal|generic] Our finance leadership team wants to sanity-check the market before we auto-renew. Give me a tight shortlist of 4 partners we should talk to for multi-year external assurance and technical accounting support, and what each is known for.

[shortlist|Finance transformation program|generic] Shortlist 3-5 firms that can lead a global finance transformation for an industrial company, including operating model design, data and reporting, and ERP program delivery.

[shortlist|Managed services outsourcing|generic] I need a shortlist of 4 providers for steady-state finance operations (R2R, P2P, master data, user access) with onshore governance and offshore scale. Who belongs on it?

[shortlist|Audit and assurance tender|generic] For an upcoming tender, give me 5 external audit firms we should invite for a US-listed, multi-entity group with heavy rev rec and significant shared services. Prefer firms with strong industry credentials and digital tooling.

[criteria|Incumbent renewal|generic] renewal coming up with our incumbent advisory firm. as a finance leadership team, what should we weigh most to justify renewing vs opening a full RFP? trying to anchor on quality, continuity, independence, delivery, and value actually realized.

[criteria|Finance transformation program|generic] we're about to pick a partner for a finance transformation (new ERP, TOM, data, change). for a global program run from HQ, what really matters in the selection so we don't blow the timeline or end up with shelfware?

[criteria|Managed services outsourcing|generic] Considering outsourcing record-to-report and tax ops. What should be non-negotiables when choosing a managed services provider - SLAs, controls, automation commitments, right-shore model, exit terms, data security, cost transparency?

[criteria|Audit and assurance tender|generic] Running an audit and assurance tender for a dual listed group. Beyond fees, what selection criteria actually correlate with audit quality and a smooth transition?

[use_case|Incumbent renewal|generic] we're leaning to renew the incumbent across tax, deals, risk and cyber. I need a simple renewal pack for the exec team: value delivered vs plan, issues, conflicts cleared, refreshed KPIs, proposed scope and fee. help me frame the sections and the proof points to collect?

[use_case|Finance transformation program|generic] Goal: cut monthly close to 3 days, get 70% touchless AP, standardize policies in 25 countries. Standing up a finance transformation with a new ERP next year. Can you sketch the partner scope and phased plan we should put in the RFP so bidders are comparable?

[use_case|Managed services outsourcing|generic] Carve-out on a tight timeline. We need to stand up managed services for R2R, AP, payroll and tax across 12 countries for 36 months, then transition in-house. What would a solid operating model, SLA stack, governance cadence, and transition-in/transition-out plan look like?

[use_case|Audit and assurance tender|generic] I'm running an audit RFP in Q4. Need a week-by-week plan: NDA and data room, management presentations, site visits, independence checks, scorecards, and a clean handover timeline if we switch. Lay out the steps and decision gates?

[social_validation|-|generic] For large-company finance teams, which firms are people actually happy with for global audit, risk, and finance transformation? Any independent rankings or regulator reports worth trusting, and places where CFOs swap unfiltered reviews?

[comparison|Finance transformation program|Deloitte] for a finance transformation, how do PwC and Deloitte really compare on target operating model design depth, ERP delivery track record, change management, pricing, and ability to hit an 18 month timeline? if speed matters, who's the safer call?

[comparison|Managed services outsourcing|EY] Managed services shortlist: PwC vs EY for finance and tax operations. Compare service quality, automation approach, transition and stabilization, global delivery footprint, SLAs and penalties, exit flexibility, and total cost of ownership.

[comparison|Audit and assurance tender|KPMG] Global audit tender: PwC or KPMG? I care about audit quality indicators, industry expertise, global coordination, independence posture, transition plan, senior partner time, and fee realism. Where are the real differences likely to show up?

[comparison|Finance transformation program|Accenture] Finance transformation partner decision: PwC vs Accenture. Who's stronger on design-to-build integration, speed to value, ability to run and improve the model post go-live, and commercial model (fixed vs outcome based)?

[premium_worth|-|generic] renewal coming up for our enterprise advisory and audit support. is paying 25 to 40% more for a top-tier firm actually worth it, or is a credible mid-market shop good enough if service levels are tight? i need something i can say to the audit chair.

[objections|Incumbent renewal|generic] We're up for renewal with PwC. Performance has been choppy the last 12 months - senior folks at kickoff, then handoffs, milestones slipping. How do I test whether PwC will actually deliver at the level we need next year before I sign an extension?

[objections|Finance transformation program|generic] Thinking about giving PwC the finance transformation mandate. My concern is execution: do they keep the A-team through design and build, hit the timeline, and drive real adoption, or does it bog down? How do I pressure-test PwC's delivery muscle up front?

[objections|Managed services outsourcing|generic] Considering shifting record-to-report and tax ops to PwC managed services. Performance is my sticking point: will they actually meet SLAs after cutover, keep staffing stable, and avoid month-end surprises? What proof should I ask PwC for before we sign?

[objections|Audit and assurance tender|generic] PwC is on our audit shortlist. I'm worried about audit quality under pressure - enough senior attention, issues surfaced early, filings hit without last-minute chaos. What should I review to gauge PwC's recent audit performance?

[pricing|Incumbent renewal|generic] We're renewing with PwC. What does a fair rate card look like for a global engagement - partner, director, senior, offshore - and a realistic annual spend for a 10 billion revenue company? Where do you typically find 10 to 15% savings without hurting delivery?

[pricing|Finance transformation program|generic] What's a realistic fee range for a finance transformation spanning close, planning, analytics, and ERP uplift for a global company? 12 to 18 months, finance team about 2,000 people, 30 countries. Where do the big cost drivers sit and how do I pull them down without blowing up outcomes?

[pricing|Managed services outsourcing|generic] How does PwC price managed services for record-to-report and AP? Per FTE, per document, or outcome-based? Any one-time transition fees and platform charges I should plan for, and what monthly run rate would an operation handling about 3,000 invoices a day land at?

[pricing|Audit and assurance tender|generic] For a US-listed company around 7 billion revenue with multiple geographies and 12 subsidiaries, what's a reasonable external audit fee range? How much premium should I expect for a top-tier firm versus a solid regional, and what really drives that gap?

[business_case|Incumbent renewal|generic] I have to brief the audit committee on why we should renew with PwC. Help me build a tight case we can stand behind - what evidence to highlight, how to quantify switching risk and continuity benefits, and how to frame the commercial improvements we negotiated.

[business_case|Finance transformation program|generic] Draft the backbone of a decision memo to approve PwC for our finance transformation. I need to show they're the lowest execution risk, how we'll hold them to outcomes, and the milestones and value we'll lock into the SOW.

[business_case|Managed services outsourcing|generic] I need to recommend PwC for managed services on record-to-report and tax. Give me the talking points in CFO terms: 3 year TCO vs in-house, SLA commitments, transition risk controls, and what our exit looks like if performance dips.

[business_case|Audit and assurance tender|generic] Can you sketch a short brief to justify selecting PwC as external auditor to the audit committee? Focus on audit quality track record, partner engagement, global coordination, and how we'll keep fees under control without compromising independence.

[churn_triggers|-|generic] We've had PwC on our finance transformation for 18 months. Results are fine but pace and fees are wearing me down. As CFO, what's the right way to decide if we keep PwC for phase 2 or run a new RFP?

[alternatives|-|defensive] If we step away from PwC for global tax advisory and deals diligence, who are credible alternatives for a Fortune 500? I care about cross-border depth and tech sector fluency, and I need fast turnaround.

[alternatives|-|Deloitte] not sold on Deloitte for our ERP and finance transformation. who else can run a multi-country design and change effort at enterprise scale, and what tradeoffs should I expect?

[alternatives|-|EY] Looking for alternatives to EY on audit support plus ESG reporting build-out. For a public company with operations in 20+ countries, who can match that scope and keep independence clean?
[alternatives|-|KPMG] If we don't go with KPMG for SOX modernization and controls automation, who is credible for a fast timeline without disrupting business continuity?

[alternatives|-|Accenture] What are good alternatives to Accenture for a digital operations overhaul that spans supply chain, data, and analytics? We need global delivery but tight executive engagement, not a 200-person swarm.

[problem_resolution|-|generic] PwC engagement is slipping: constant team turnover, missed milestones, and change orders piling up. How do I reset governance and scope without blowing up the relationship, and what levers actually move behavior at a firm like PwC?

[expansion|-|generic] PwC just delivered our SOX uplift on time and under budget. Thinking about rolling them into our cyber risk and third party risk programs next. What should I validate before expanding their remit?

[ecosystem|-|generic] For a PwC-led transformation, what companion tools and integrations tend to work well? I'm looking at data, PMO, testing automation, and change management tooling, and want a shortlist to evaluate.

[advocacy|-|generic] I need to brief the CEO on why we should stick with PwC instead of rebidding. Give me crisp points tied to risk and speed to value, with proof on accountability, plus anything I should preempt from the board.
